name: WT Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: WT Microelectronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells electronic and communication components. Its products are used in various fields, including communication, computing, consumer electronics, industry and instrument, IOT, and automotive. The company is also involved in the investment, trading, and software services businesses. WT Microelectronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
